import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'research-agent'})
BT="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rw=BT.strip().split("\n"); hd=rw[0].split(); M62={}
for r in rw[1:]:
    p=r.split()
    for b,v in zip(hd,p[1:]): M62[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return M62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11.0,ge=-1.0):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mm[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    sm=np.array([[sc(a,b) for b in s2] for a in s1],float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pm=Mm[i-1];px=Ix[i-1];py=Iy[i-1]
        c=np.stack([pm+go,px+ge,py+go]); Ix[i]=c.max(0); pX[i]=c.argmax(0)
        dg=np.stack([pm[:-1],px[:-1],py[:-1]]); Mm[i,1:]=dg.max(0)+sm[i-1]; pM[i,1:]=dg.argmax(0)
        Mi=Mm[i];Xi=Ix[i];Yi=Iy[i];pYi=pY[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c0=Mi[j-1]+go;c1=Xi[j-1]+go;c2=Yi[j-1]+ge
            if c0>=c1 and c0>=c2: Yi[j]=c0;pYi[j]=0
            elif c1>=c2: Yi[j]=c1;pYi[j]=1
            else: Yi[j]=c2;pYi[j]=2
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: st=2
        elif j==0: st=1
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=int(ns)
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;st=int(ns)
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;st=int(ns)
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))
def mapp(s1,s2):
    a1,a2=nw(s1,s2); i=j=0; mp={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-': i+=1
        if c2!='-': j+=1
        if c1!='-': mp[i]=(c1,c2,(j if c2!='-' else None))
    return mp,a1,a2
def fa(a):
    t=S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n"); return "".join(t[1:])
SEQ={k:fa(v) for k,v in dict(ScEaf3="Q12432",ScRco1="Q04779",CaEaf3="Q59K07",CaRco1="A0A1D8PR21").items()}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def catoms(text,chains):
    cols=[];inl=False;inc=False;out=defaultdict(list);st=False;idx=None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        s=line.strip()
        if s.startswith('loop_'):
            if st: break
            inl=True;cols=[];inc=False;continue
        if inl and s.startswith('_atom_site.'):
            cols.append(s.split('.')[1]);inc=True;idx={c:i for i,c in enumerate(cols)};continue
        if inc:
            if s.startswith('#') or s.startswith('_') or s.startswith('loop_'):
                if st: break
                inc=False;inl=False;continue
            p=s.split()
            if len(p)!=len(cols): continue
            st=True
            if p[idx['group_PDB']] not in ('ATOM','HETATM'): continue
            ch=p[idx['auth_asym_id']]
            if ch not in chains or p[idx['type_symbol']]=='H': continue
            cm=p[idx['label_comp_id']]
            if cm not in AA3: continue
            out[ch].append((int(p[idx['auth_seq_id']]),cm,float(p[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(p[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(p[idx['Cartn_z']])))
    return out
def pcon(A,Bb,cut=4.5):
    Ac=np.array([a[2:] for a in A]);Bc=np.array([b[2:] for b in Bb])
    ra=np.array([a[0] for a in A]);rb=np.array([b[0] for b in Bb]);best={}
    for i in range(0,len(Ac),2500):
        d=np.sqrt(((Ac[i:i+2500,None,:]-Bc[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1))
        ii,jj=np.where(d<cut)
        for x,y in zip(ii,jj):
            k=(int(ra[i+x]),int(rb[y]));v=float(d[x,y])
            if k not in best or v<best[k]: best[k]=v
    return best
def cls(a,b):
    if b in (None,'-'): return 'lost (gap)'
    if a==b: return 'identical'
    s=sc(a,b); return 'conservative' if s>0 else ('neutral' if s==0 else 'non-conservative')

# --- independent crystallographic replicate: 8I3F Eaf3(A)-Rco1(B) at 1.62 A ---
txt=S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/8I3F.cif",timeout=240).text
ch=catoms(txt,{'A','B','C'})
# sanity: author numbering vs UniProt
mism=[(r,AA3[c]) for r,c,*_ in ch['A'] if SEQ['ScEaf3'][r-1]!=AA3[c]]
print("8I3F chain A numbering mismatches vs ScEaf3 UniProt:",len(set(mism)))
mism2=[(r,AA3[c]) for r,c,*_ in ch['B'] if SEQ['ScRco1'][r-1]!=AA3[c]]
print("8I3F chain B numbering mismatches vs ScRco1 UniProt:",len(set(mism2)))
print("8I3F Eaf3 modelled range:",min(a[0] for a in ch['A']),"-",max(a[0] for a in ch['A']),
      "| Rco1 modelled range:",min(a[0] for a in ch['B']),"-",max(a[0] for a in ch['B']))
cx=pcon(ch['A'],ch['B'])
e_x=sorted({k[0] for k in cx}); r_x=sorted({k[1] for k in cx})
print(f"8I3F: {len(cx)} contact pairs | Eaf3 residues {len(e_x)} | Rco1 residues {len(r_x)}")
# H3 peptide contacts
cxh=pcon(ch['A'],ch['C']); cxh2=pcon(ch['B'],ch['C'])
print("8I3F H3 peptide contacts: Eaf3",sorted({k[0] for k in cxh}),"| Rco1",sorted({k[1] for k in cxh2.keys()})[:1],len({k[0] for k in cxh2}))

# --- cryo-EM reference set from 8TOF + 8KD2 ---
spec={'8TOF':{'eaf3':['D','E'],'rco1':['F','G']},'8KD2':{'eaf3':['D','F'],'rco1':['E','G']}}
e_em=set(); r_em=set(); e_res=set()
for pid,sp in spec.items():
    t2=S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=240).text
    c2=catoms(t2,set(sp['eaf3']+sp['rco1']))
    for c in sp['eaf3']: e_res|={a[0] for a in c2[c]}
    for a_ in sp['eaf3']:
        for b_ in sp['rco1']:
            for (x,y) in pcon(c2[a_],c2[b_]): e_em.add(x); r_em.add(y)
inter=set(e_x)&e_em
print(f"\nEaf3 interface agreement: cryo-EM set n={len(e_em)}, crystal set n={len(e_x)}, overlap={len(inter)}"
      f" ({100*len(inter)/len(e_x):.0f}% of crystal set reproduced in cryo-EM)")
cons_core=sorted(inter)  # residues contacting Rco1 in BOTH an X-ray and a cryo-EM structure
mpE,_,_=mapp(SEQ['ScEaf3'],SEQ['CaEaf3'])
rows=[]
for p in cons_core:
    a,b,q=mpE[p]; rows.append(dict(ScEaf3_pos=p,Sc_aa=a,CaEaf3_pos=q,Ca_aa=b,status=cls(a,b)))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); vc=df.status.value_counts()
print("\nHigh-confidence Eaf3 core (contacts Rco1 in both 8I3F crystal and cryo-EM):",len(df),"residues")
print(vc.to_string())
nid=int((df.status=='identical').sum()); ncons=int((df.status.isin(['identical','conservative'])).sum())
print(f"identical {nid}/{len(df)} = {100*nid/len(df):.1f}% ; identical+conservative {ncons}/{len(df)} = {100*ncons/len(df):.1f}%")
# background on resolved Eaf3 surface
bgp=[p for p in sorted(e_res) if p in mpE and p not in inter]
bg=[(mpE[p][0],mpE[p][1]) for p in bgp if mpE[p][1]!='-']
bi=sum(1 for x,y in bg if x==y)
orr,pv=fisher_exact([[nid,len(df)-nid],[bi,len(bg)-bi]])
print(f"background resolved non-core Eaf3: {bi}/{len(bg)} = {100*bi/len(bg):.1f}% ; OR={orr:.2f}, Fisher p={pv:.3g}")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv("eaf3_core_interface_xray_cryoem_consensus.csv",index=False)

# --- is there any experimental structure of Eaf3 with a NuA4/TINTIN partner (Eaf5/Eaf7)? ---
for acc,nm in [("Q08465","Eaf7"),("P53911","Eaf5_check")]:
    try:
        jj=S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=60).json()
        print(f"\n{acc} = {jj['proteinDescription']['recommendedName']['fullName']['value']}; PDB:",
              [x['id'] for x in jj.get('uniProtKBCrossReferences',[]) if x['database']=='PDB'])
    except Exception as ex: print(acc,"ERR",ex)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,3.2))
allp=sorted(e_res)
col={'identical':'#17633f','conservative':'#6fae8c','neutral':'#c9c9c9','non-conservative':'#d98b32','lost (gap)':'#b1322c'}
ax.scatter(allp,[0]*len(allp),s=8,c='#e8e8e8',marker='s',label='resolved, no Rco1 contact')
for st,c in col.items():
    pts=df[df.status==st].ScEaf3_pos.tolist()
    if pts: ax.scatter(pts,[0]*len(pts),s=34,c=c,marker='s',label=st)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel('ScEaf3 residue number')
ax.set_title('Eaf3 residues contacting Rco1 in both the 1.62 A crystal (8I3F) and cryo-EM (8TOF/8KD2),\ncoloured by conservation in C. albicans Eaf3',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(ncol=3,fontsize=7,frameon=False,loc='upper left',bbox_to_anchor=(0,-0.35))
ax.axhspan(-0.02,0.02,xmin=0,xmax=0,color='w')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
